title: Hookline webhook event
description: The JSON body of every webhook delivery. Receivers must ignore properties they do not know: new optional properties may be added without a new version.

id.description: The event id; the same in every delivery and retry of this event (Hookline-Event-Id).

type.description: Dotted lowercase words, at least two, such as invoice.paid.
type.$comment: Python's re lets $ match before a final newline; Go's regexp does not. The not-pattern makes both sides reject it.

data.description: The tenant's payload; its shape depends on type.
